explicit_summary_lines: „Chat wechseln“ also accepts the Kit's external handoff projection v2 (KIT-GF-094, Kit 1.2.0): the package files stay byte-identical across regenerations, and a new run of the Kit's generator — a new run_id in the ignored runtime identity with the exact HEAD and the validator PASS of the same run — is the evidence; the v1 evidence is unchanged, and an unknown projection contract is BLOCKED instead of guessed. Verified against a Kit-main wheel in a disposable copy and against Kit 1.1.10, with regression tests for every rejected case (AGP_HANDOFF_PROJECTION_V2_CONSUMER_V1). The Kit findings window no longer counts a fix marked "unreleased" as installed (AGP_UNRELEASED_FIX_NOT_INSTALLED_V1); KIT-GF-094 and KIT-GF-095 are recorded; build `release-0.3.7-r1`.

Work orders whose self-test mode is `'--self-test' in sys.argv[1:]` are accepted, as the work-order rule („sys.argv or argparse“) allows; three correct orders of the live Kit 1.1.11 adoption were rejected for it, and the rejection now names every accepted form (AGP_SELF_TEST_ARGV_SLICE_V1). Kit 1.1.11 adopted through „Kit übernehmen“ (signature f0a6c8f0abcb841f121017f6, #428; projection v1 kept, v2 ships dormant). Kit findings register follows Kit 1.1.11 (retest PASS 56, FAIL 0, evidence docs/validation/evidence/kit-1.1.11-adoption.json): KIT-GF-095, the governed return after `kit update`, is verified fixed; KIT-GF-094 stays open until the release that activates v2; build `release-0.3.7-r2`.

Kit 1.2.0 (release B, external handoff projection v2 active) adopted from 1.1.11 through „Kit übernehmen“ (#432): the signed plan migrated the handoff projection (`handoff.projection_contract_min: 2`, `.gitignore`). Since then a merge is no longer followed by a „Refresh successor package“ PR, and „Chat wechseln“ leaves no tracked change. Kit findings register follows Kit 1.2.0 (retest PASS 59, FAIL 0, evidence docs/validation/evidence/kit-1.2.0-adoption.json): KIT-GF-094 and KIT-GF-099 are verified fixed; no Kit finding is open.
